keep_features.feature_value: Uses strong profanity and emphatic informal phrasing
keep_features.rationale: Contains explicit profanity alongside emphatic wording.

keep_features.feature_value: Justifies/frames border enforcement as not deportation/kidnapping
keep_features.rationale: Directly argues for a specific interpretation of enforcement actions.

keep_features.feature_value: Multiple political actors and acronyms (MTG, AOC)
keep_features.rationale: Several named/abbreviated political figures appear in a single sentence.
Explicitly references gun-law changes and Second Amendment rights.

keep_features.feature_value: Insults political figures using derogatory labels
keep_features.rationale: Uses mocking/derogatory descriptions rather than neutral claims.

keep_features.feature_value: Mirror shifts praise to DeSantis and attacks AOC/socialists
keep_features.rationale: Mirror re-targets positive framing toward a different actor and negative framing toward AOC.

keep_features.feature_value: References legal/political institutions and roles (AG, DOJ, Trump control)
keep_features.rationale: Discusses specific institutional actors and appointment/control claims embedded in argument.

keep_features.feature_value: Implicitly endorses leadership choice as "boots on the ground"
keep_features.rationale: Evaluative, promotional framing urging approval of the chosen leader.

remove_features.feature_value: Direct harm/violence wish toward a political figure
remove_features.evidence_span: "Hopefully a tank runs over the bastard Trump."
remove_features.rationale: Explicitly expresses a violent outcome targeted at a named politician.

remove_features.feature_value: Labeling outgroup ideology (communists/fascists) to claim national ownership boundary
remove_features.rationale: Uses ideological outgroup terms in a boundary/territorial assertion.

remove_features.feature_value: Uses insulting/derogatory language toward a politician
remove_features.rationale: Degrading metaphor/insult targets the opposing president.

remove_features.feature_value: Strong factual-sounding harm claim about sanctions
remove_features.rationale: Presents a direct causative assertion (sanctions kill people).

remove_features.feature_value: Single emphatic declarative slang tag (crisis) as nonsense
remove_features.rationale: Uses quoted term plus taboo language to negate the concept.

remove_features.feature_value: Contains explicit profanity plus targeted political anger
remove_features.rationale: Includes repeated explicit profanity aimed at political actors/groups.

remove_features.feature_value: Accuses a party of covert racism while instructing re-labeling
remove_features.evidence_span: "be as racist as you want"; "just don't label it"
remove_features.rationale: Advocates wrongdoing by framing it as an untouchable but permissible act with conditions.

remove_features.feature_value: Slogan-style party-to-stance contrast separated by commas
remove_features.rationale: Uses compact political slogan structure with exclamation and party abbreviations.
